question: How can I check my order status?
answer: Open Your Account > Orders to view the current status and order details. If the order is not listed, contact support with the order reference shown in your confirmation message.

question: I did not receive an order confirmation
answer: A confirmation message is usually sent after an order is placed. Check your spam or promotions folder and confirm that the order appears under Your Account > Orders. If it is still missing, ask support to review the order.

question: How do I track a shipment or tracking number?
answer: Open Your Account > Orders and select the order to see its shipment tracking link, when available. Tracking can take some time to update after a parcel is handed to the carrier.

question: Why has my estimated delivery date changed?
answer: Delivery dates are estimates and may change because of carrier delays, weather, or operational issues. Check the latest date in Your Account > Orders. If the order is overdue, contact support for a review.

question: Can I change my delivery address?
answer: An address can usually be changed only before the order is packed or dispatched. Check Your Account > Orders for available options. If the order is already dispatched, contact support; a change may not be possible.

question: My order delivery is delayed
answer: We’re sorry your order is late. Check the latest tracking details in Your Account > Orders. If the estimated delivery date has passed or tracking has not moved, contact support so the shipment can be reviewed.

question: The delivery attempt failed or I missed the courier
answer: Check the tracking page for the next delivery attempt or any instructions from the carrier. If no new attempt is shown, contact support for help reviewing the shipment.

question: My parcel says delivered but I cannot find it
answer: Check with other household members or your building’s reception and review the delivery details. If the parcel is still missing, contact support to investigate the delivery record.

question: Will my order arrive in separate packages?
answer: Some orders are shipped in more than one package when items come from different locations. Check each shipment under Your Account > Orders; packages may have different tracking links and delivery dates.

question: How long do I have to return an item?
answer: Eligible items can be requested for return within 10 days of delivery, provided they meet the item’s return conditions. Open Your Account > Orders, select the item, and check whether the return option is available.

question: The item I received is damaged or defective
answer: We’re sorry the item arrived damaged. Open Your Account > Orders and choose the order to check the return or replacement options. If those options are unavailable, contact support for a review.

question: I received the wrong item
answer: We’re sorry you received the wrong item. Open Your Account > Orders and select the affected order to check return or replacement options. If no option is available, contact support to resolve the issue.

question: An item is missing from my package or box
answer: First check whether the order has multiple shipments under Your Account > Orders. If all packages are marked delivered and an item is still missing, contact support to review the order contents.

question: When will my return refund arrive?
answer: After an eligible return is received and inspected, the refund is initiated according to the return status shown in Your Account > Orders. The time for funds to appear can depend on the payment provider.

question: My refund is still pending
answer: Check the refund status in Your Account > Orders. Once a refund is marked as initiated, the time for it to appear depends on the original payment provider. If the displayed status has not changed, contact support for a review.

question: Where will my refund be sent?
answer: Approved refunds are normally sent to the original payment method. The time it takes to appear depends on the bank, card issuer, or payment provider. Check Your Account > Orders for the refund status.

question: Can I cancel an order before it is shipped?
answer: Open Your Account > Orders and select the order. If it has not been packed or dispatched, a Cancel Order option may be available. If you cannot see that option, contact support to check what is possible.

question: Can I cancel an order that has already shipped?
answer: An order that has already been dispatched may not be cancellable. Check the order page for current options. After delivery, you may be able to request a return if the item meets the return conditions.

question: When will I get money back after cancellation?
answer: If an order is successfully cancelled, any eligible refund is sent to the original payment method. Check the cancellation and refund status under Your Account > Orders; processing time depends on the payment provider.

question: My payment failed or was declined
answer: Check that your payment method is active and that the details entered are correct, then try again. If the payment continues to fail, use another available payment method or contact your bank or payment provider.

question: Money was deducted but my order failed
answer: If money was deducted for a failed order, the payment may be awaiting reversal by the payment provider. Check your order history and bank statement. If the amount is not returned within your provider’s usual timeframe, contact support with the order reference; never share an OTP, PIN, or CVV.

question: I was charged twice for one order
answer: Check your bank statement and order history to confirm whether both entries are completed charges or one is pending. If both charges are completed, contact support for a payment review. Never share an OTP, PIN, or card CVV.

question: Which payment methods or cash on delivery options are available?
answer: Available payment methods are shown at checkout for the selected address and items. Cash on delivery may not be available for every order or location. Review the checkout page for the options currently offered.

question: Where can I download my invoice?
answer: Open Your Account > Orders, select the completed order, and look for the Invoice or Download Invoice option. If no invoice is available, contact support to request a review.

question: Is it safe to share my OTP, PIN, password, or card CVV?
answer: No. Our company will never ask you to share an OTP, PIN, password, or card CVV/CVC. Do not send these details to anyone in chat or by phone. If someone claiming to represent us requests them, stop the conversation and contact support through the official app or website.
